brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich made inflammatory statements directed at Arab voters as ballots were being tallied following the election, Al Jazeera English reported. The remarks came as both major political blocs faced uncertainty over their paths to forming a governing coalition.

The statements from the right-wing leaders marked a sharp escalation in rhetoric targeting Israel's Arab minority during the sensitive period of vote counting and early coalition negotiations.
dek: Netanyahu and Smotrich rail against Arab voters as rival political camps face an uncertain path to power.
title: Netanyahu and Smotrich attack Arab voters as Israel counts election results
